summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js — a 727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle with hex-mangled identifiers, a shuffled numeric string-array, and array-rotation decoder functions. The package is advertised as a webpack loader for typed-css-modules and has no legitimate need to fetch a language runtime or execute a large opaque payload at install time. This is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern used to evade Node-based static analyzers: the payload is invoked before any Node code path is inspected and executes under Bun instead of Node. The package is published under the @ornikar npm scope while its repository field points at github.com/olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader, and the upstream olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader project contains no such preinstall behavior — consistent with a scope-hijack or lookalike republish that carries the dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
